name: 飞书
description: 飞书待办、日程、消息、审批接入：用 lark-cli 扫码/桌面客户端授权一次即可，无需在开放平台手动创建应用。

composer.prompt: 使用飞书 lark-cli 查询或处理待办、日程、消息和审批，涉及写操作前先确认范围。

setup.instructions: 免控制台：先在终端安装并初始化 lark-cli（npm i -g @larksuite/cli），运行 lark-cli config init --new，按提示在浏览器完成自动建应用；再运行 lark-cli auth login --domain task,calendar,im,approval，用飞书扫码/桌面客户端授权一次即可。之后小珀就能直接查你的待办、日程和消息。
setup.primaryCta: 查看 lark-cli 使用指南

en.description: Feishu/Lark todos, calendar, messages, approvals via lark-cli — authorize once with scan/desktop login, no manual app creation on the console.

composer.prompt: Use lark-cli to query or handle todos, calendar, messages, and approvals; confirm scope before write actions.

setup.instructions: No console needed: install lark-cli (npm i -g @larksuite/cli), run `lark-cli config init --new` and finish the browser verification to auto-provision an app, then run `lark-cli auth login --domain task,calendar,im,approval` and authorize once with a scan/desktop login.
